title: Annotate the moment that matters

steps.say: Jazan against the Kingdom, from the panel that stood out. Default colours and a legend: correct, and silent about the moment that matters.
Your colours, not the defaults: the accent for the region, grey for the yardstick. slice_max(date, by = region) finds the last point of each line, which is where its name goes instead of a legend.

Find the turning point with code, slice_min(), then mark it three ways: a point on the line, a shaded period behind it and a note that says what it is. The shading comes first in the code, so it is drawn under the lines.
since holds each line's change from the turning point, as a named vector for the title. But read the subtitle: in a computer, 6.6 minus 7.4 is not exactly −0.8.
Round a number before it goes into a sentence. Jazan's 3.6 looked fine only by luck; the rule is for every number, not just the one that went wrong.

final:
---
title: "When Jazan turned"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
pair <- read_csv("unemployment.csv") |>
  filter(region %in% c("Jazan", "Kingdom"))
ends <- pair |> slice_max(date, by = region)
low <- pair |>
  filter(region == "Jazan") |>
  slice_min(rate, n = 1)
since <- pair |>
  filter(date >= low$date) |>
  group_by(region) |>
  summarise(change = last(rate) - first(rate)) |>
  mutate(change = round(change, 1)) |>
  deframe()
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5.5
ggplot(pair, aes(date, rate, colour = region)) +
  annotate("rect", fill = "#F5F7FA",
           xmin = low$date, xmax = max(pair$date),
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = low, size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = low$date, y = low$rate - 0.3,
           vjust = 1, colour = "#00803A",
           label = str_glue("Lowest: {low$rate}%, ",
                            "{low$quarter}")) +
  geom_text(data = ends, aes(label = region),
            hjust = -0.15, size = 4.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Jazan = "#00803A",
                                 Kingdom = "grey50"),
                      guide = "none") +
  scale_x_date(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.14))) +
  labs(title = str_glue(
         "Jazan tracked the Kingdom until ",
         "{low$quarter}, then rose ",
         "{since['Jazan']} points"),
       subtitle = str_glue(
         "Unemployment rate, %. Since ",
         "{low$quarter}, the Kingdom moved ",
         "{since['Kingdom']}"),
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```
